name: @tedix/cms-runtime
description: Cloudflare Worker that serves multi-tenant CMS sites and marketing domains with Dynamic Workers.

scripts.dev: bun run clear-port && bun ../../scripts/dev-local.ts -- vp dev
scripts.deploy:production: bun run types && vp build --mode production && cf deploy --mode production --prebuilt --message ${GIT_SHA:-${GITHUB_SHA:-unknown}}
scripts.test:run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd ../cms/templates/tedix && vp test run && bun scripts/check-agent-discovery.ts && bun scripts/check-cache-key.ts && bun scripts/check-tenant-emdash-encryption.ts && bun scripts/check-edge-cache-headers.ts && bun scripts/check-tenant-ai-search.ts && bun scripts/check-tenant-egress.ts && bun scripts/check-tenant-internal-auth.ts && bun scripts/check-webmcp.ts
scripts.type-check: bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd ../cms/templates/tedix && bun run types && tsc --noEmit
